infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to pinpoint flood hazards and find nearby alerts.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used to take photos of flood conditions for responder verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is used to select images of flood incidents to assist rescue teams.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow FloodWatch to use your location to identify nearby flood hazards and tag incident coordinates.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow FloodWatch to access your photos to attach flood evidence to your report.
